root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR #309 PR Readiness Stage 1 did not model external-state semantic validation, lock lifecycle and recovery, targeted snapshot transactions, target-set publication and recovery, current-gate repair transactions, or synchronized fixture-count contracts as explicit review threat families. GitHub review therefore became the first exhaustive adversarial harness across these related safety boundaries, while the churn classifier left 36 of the first 61 connector comments unknown until this repair; Review 33 exposed same-label ZIP discovery before canonical publication transaction ownership, Review 34 exposed unconditional UTF-8 decoding of binary evidence during BR1 matrix discovery, Review 35 exposed a truthiness condition that silently accepted missing or blank target-set journal state, Review 36 exposed unreachable orphaned-writer prepared recovery plus fail-open malformed PID and ambiguous-journal legacy release checks, Review 37 exposed missing final canonical folder/ZIP byte parity plus BR1 matrix truncation at nested headings, Review 38 exposed shared lock-inventory collapse of present invalid owner-process values into the intentional absent-marker state, Review 39 exposed prepared-journal checks limited to legacy release plus unconditional current-member rollback over out-of-band drift, Review 40 exposed cross-subsection BR1 candidate field borrowing plus affirmative PR-state token matching inside negated clauses, and Review 41 exposed normalized-text source identity bypass for UTF-8-decodable binary or opaque files.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: The review-churn classifier and matrix now classify every PR #309 connector comment into a source-truth-backed family, bind each new family to implementation and adversarial fixtures, replay representative connector comments, retain unknown-comment guardrails, isolate every BR1 candidate at the next option or Markdown subsection, reject negated active PR states, compare every mapped source against exact Git-object bytes even when UTF-8-decodable, require exact target-set journal states across every release path, prove bounded orphaned-writer prepared rollback, preserve out-of-band current-member drift and prepared recovery evidence, fail closed on malformed legacy owner/journal evidence and present invalid owner-process values in the shared inventory, enforce final canonical folder/ZIP parity, preserve nested BR1 matrix headings, and require exact live counts plus this historical receipt before current-head review can satisfy the churn gate.

Prepared target-set recovery now admits only an exact orphaned-writer rollback, while legacy missing-workload release blocks malformed owner PIDs and every matching transaction-like journal state other than exact Committed.

Shared lock inventory now distinguishes absent/Not recorded owner-process markers from present invalid values and classifies blank, null, boolean, nonnumeric, zero, negative, and non-integral values as malformed.

Every ordinary, stale-completed, context-manager, cleanup, and recovery release now rechecks matching transaction journals before preparation and under the guard; current-member rollback restores only known pre/post bytes and preserves drift plus the prepared journal.
BR1 candidates now end at the next option or Markdown subsection so later summary fields cannot satisfy them, and semantic currentness rejects not-open/not-current/not-live/not-active PR states.
Mapped Source Truth Context files now compare available folder/ZIP bytes directly with expected Git-object bytes even when their content decodes as UTF-8.
